quiz_title: 🧠 الذكاء الاصطناعي للصغار - PicToBlox with AI - Challenge 1

questions.question: What is the core branch of computer science that teaches computers how to see, hear, and make smart decisions like humans?
questions.explanation: Spot on! Artificial Intelligence enables computers to mimic human intelligence, speech, and sight.

questions.question: Which PicToBlox extension is used to recognize faces and track facial coordinates through cameras?
questions.explanation: Correct! The Face Detection extension adds blocks to analyze camera frames for faces.

questions.question: Which block must be called first to reveal the live webcam video feed on your stage workspace?
options: turn on video on stage with (0)% transparency
questions.explanation: Excellent! Turning video on stage displays the live camera stream so coordinates can be mapped.

questions.question: Which block is called to force the AI computer to analyze a captured camera frame for human faces?
questions.explanation: Perfect! 'analyze image from camera' triggers the AI engine to scan the frame for facial structures.

questions.question: What coordinates does the AI return to help you track the center position of a detected face?
options: Both X and Y coordinates of the face
questions.explanation: Spot on! The AI returns both X and Y coordinates, letting sprites follow your movements exactly.

questions.question: If you want a wizard hat sprite to follow your face on screen, what block script should you snap inside a forever loop?
options: go to X(get face X) Y(get face Y)
questions.explanation: Great! Running 'go to face X, Y' inside a forever loop makes the sprite stick to your face like a real filter!

questions.question: Which face coordinate increases as you move your head vertically upward in front of your camera?
questions.explanation: Excellent! Upward vertical motion raises the Y coordinate value.

questions.question: Which face coordinate changes as you move your head horizontally left and right?
questions.explanation: Perfect! Left-to-right horizontal shifts modify the X coordinate value.

questions.question: How can you dynamically adjust the size of your face filter mask (e.g. funny glasses) when you lean closer to the camera?
options: Set sprite size to a fixed 100%
Set sprite size to match the 'get face width' block value
questions.explanation: Spot on! The 'get face width' block increases as you get closer, scaling filters perfectly.

questions.question: Does the Face Detection extension require a functioning camera to track your face live?
options: Yes, it needs a working camera or webcam input to capture video frames
questions.explanation: Great! A camera is essential to capture the live feed analyzed by the face coordinates engine.

questions.question: Coding Task: Write block pseudo-code to turn on the camera and continuously analyze images inside a forever loop.
questions.task_hint: turn on video on stage -> forever (analyze image from camera)
questions.explanation: Outstanding! Placing the analysis block inside a forever loop ensures the AI scans frames repeatedly for real-time tracking!

questions.question: Coding Task: Write block pseudo-code to make a sprite go to the detected face's center coordinates X and Y.
questions.task_hint: go to X(get face X) Y(get face Y)
questions.explanation: Perfect! This simple script binds your filter sprites to the face coordinates instantly.
